Auto-answered by the orchestrator clarify-respond workflow.

Checkpoint: both classifiers read (`orchestrate_poll_process.sh:13725`, `promote_main_cycle.sh:216`). They hold the same case lists. Code patterns are matched before the catch-all `*.md` non-code branch, so new code entries go in the first branch.

DECISIONS:
Q1: A
Q2: A

RATIONALE:
Q1: The issue's rule is "every root-level `*.md` the pipeline reads into model context", and `README.md` is read into model context: every trimmed prompt includes it, and prompts tell the model to read its Variables section from the repository. Picking A is also the fail-closed direction and keeps today's behaviour. A human commit that touches only `README.md` already defers promotion, so A takes nothing away. The worst a misclassification can do is delay promotion by one day.
Q2: Pending `agents.d/*.md` fragments are rendered into the agents text before it reaches model context (`build_static_context.sh`, the judge context builder at `orchestrate_poll_process.sh:1455`), and they fold into `agents.md` at release time. They steer the pipeline exactly as `agents.md` does. `AGENTS.md` is read as an alternative to `agents.md` (`orchestrate_poll_process.sh:1448-1451`), so it must be classified the same way. Leaving either out would let a pipeline-steering change skip the smoke test, which goes against the issue's intent.

EXECUTION PLAN (required for any non-letter decision):
None. Both answers are lettered choices. Notes for the planner:
- In both copies of the classifier, add these names to the first, code branch, before the non-code catch-all: `README.md`, `unattended_system_instructions.md`, `ai_pipeline.md`, `agents.md`, `AGENTS.md`, `codex.md`, `probably_unnecessary_but_read_if_stuck.md`, and `agents.d/*.md`. The copies are `comprehensive_cycle_is_code_path` (`scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:13725-13730`) and the matching case in `scripts/promote_main_cycle.sh:216-219`, with its header comment at lines 50-52.
  - Keep the two case lists byte-identical.
  - Root-level names are matched exactly, except `CLAUDE.md`, which keeps its existing `*/CLAUDE.md` form.
  - `docs/*` (including `docs/plans/*.md`), `changelog.d/*.md`, `CHANGELOG.md` and other `*.md` files stay non-code. That way the motivating commit, `34ad13f`, which touched only `docs/plans/...`, is exempt.
- A commit that changes only `agents.md` or `CHANGELOG.md` and was written by `github-actions[bot]` (for example a release fold) used to be exempt. If such a commit reaches `main` other than through a verified `auto/forward-merge-stable-*` merge, it will now defer promotion when its paths are code (`agents.md`). That is the safe direction; do not add a new exemption for it in this issue. The planner should note this, and test that a bot commit touching only `CHANGELOG.md` is still exempt.
- Tests:
  - a human commit touching only `docs/plans/x.md`: no deferral;
  - a human commit touching `docs/x.md` plus `scripts/x.sh`: deferral;
  - commits touching each of `unattended_system_instructions.md`, `README.md`, `agents.md` and `agents.d/123-x.md`: deferral;
  - the cycle-start classifier in `promote_main_cycle.sh` updated to match.

ESCALATION (required for any ESCALATE decision):
None.
